definitions: A fictional character who is the titular protagonist of an 1846 penny dreadful, The String of Pearls, and has appeared in various adaptations since.
A legendary barber in London who murders his customers by slitting their throats and then, with the help of Mrs. Lovett, bakes their bodies into meat pies to be sold in her shop.
examples: The story of Sweeney Todd has been adapted many times.
Sweeney Todd is a character often associated with horror.
The musical 'Sweeney Todd: The Demon Barber of Fleet Street' is very famous.
